name: RC-B10-0157/2026 – After § 2 – Am 1
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on human trafficking and grave human rights violations linked to the recruitment of non-Russian nationals, in particular from Africa, for Russia’s war of aggression in Ukraine
part_text: 2a. Stresses that ending Russia’s war of aggression is essential to putting an end to the human trafficking and grave human rights violations linked to the recruitment of non-Russian nationals; calls for the EU to work towards achieving this goal in accordance with international law;
